entries.name: Claire O'Connor

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride arrival in Jackson, June 11, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested June 11, 1961 in Jackson. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest but not the disposition, any transfer, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.convicted: Yes - breach of the peace; conviction appealed
updates.sentence: Sentenced to four months in jail after the June 11, 1961 Jackson Freedom Ride arrest. Held in Jackson before transfer to Parchman; released on appeal bond July 3, 1961.

entries.rationale: MNHS individually identifies the six Minnesota riders, overnight detention following June11 arrest and next-day sentencing, and separate July3/July24 releases. OConnor additionally corroborated by contemporary October26 Minneapolis Spokesman p1.
